summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with two tests (binary 2D and empty class). Nothing was run, per instructions; the math was checked by hand against the spec's acceptance cases (binary: loss 0 correct / 1 flipped; empty class: 0 / 1; batch-of-two: TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss 0.333). Choices beyond the spec: the stored matrix is also cast to the probability dtype on each forward call, and the constructor Raises section lists only the square-matrix and reduction errors. No commits were made.
